[[Crimson Skull Priest]]s are the strongest [[monk]]s of the [[Crimson Skull]], above [[Crimson Skull Mender]]s and [[Crimson Skull Healer]]s.

In normal mode they are not much trouble as Orison of Healing won't heal their allies well. In Hard mode, they have access to [[Healing Burst]], so it's best taking them out before fighting other enemies.
